gloss.en: The totality of space, time, matter and energy; also a complete conceptual world.
gloss.zh-Hans: 空间、时间、物质与能量的整体；也可指完整的概念世界。

meaning.en: The totality of space, time, matter and energy; also a complete conceptual world.
meaning.zh-Hans: 空间、时间、物质与能量的整体；也可指完整的概念世界。

rationale.en: Translation is kept as the lexical baseline. Language Book mapping begins with the independently evidenced semantic operations inside Latin universus and compares Chinese candidates without claiming cognacy.
rationale.zh-Hans: 翻译仅作为词义底座；Language Book Mapping 从拉丁语 universus 内部有独立证据的语义操作出发，再比较汉语候选，不主张同源。

summary.en: Latin universus is historically analyzed as unus + versus (the participial form of vertere): one + turned, hence all together or whole. Chinese character histories are evaluated separately.
summary.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 universus 的标准历史分析为 unus + versus（vertere 的分词形式）：一＋转成，继而表示共同整体；汉字词史另行评估。

claim.en: universus: unus + versus / verto, ‘turned into one; combined into one whole.’
轉 is glossed as 運也 in Shuowen; later lexicographic material records motion and rotation senses.
claim.zh-Hans: 《说文》释“轉”为“運也”；后世字书记录移动、旋转义。

claim.en: 斡 has an independently attested turn/rotate sense: ‘斡，轉也.’
claim.zh-Hans: “斡”有独立可证的旋转义：“斡，轉也”。

claim.en: 渦 is attested as 回川 with the gloss 旋流, supporting eddy/whirlpool rather than a cross-language origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: “渦”见“回川”并注“旋流”，支持旋流／漩涡义，不支持跨语言同源。

claim.en: Huainanzi distinguishes 宙 as past-to-present time and 宇 as the four directions plus above and below.
claim.zh-Hans: 《淮南子》以“宙”指古往今来的时间，以“宇”指四方上下的空间。

summary.en: Modern Mandarin wò/wō forms are recorded as a testable sound–meaning cluster. Shared modern syllables do not establish common Chinese ancestry or relation to Latin VERS/VERT.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代普通话 wò／wō 形式作为可检验音义簇记录；现代音节相同既不证明汉字彼此同源，也不证明它们与拉丁 VERS／VERT 同源。

claim.en: Modern 斡 wò, 涡 wō, 窝 wō and 蜗 wō may be compared around TURN / CURVE / ROTATION, with separate lexical evidence for every character.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代“斡 wò、涡 wō、窝 wō、蜗 wō”可围绕 TURN／CURVE／ROTATION 比较，但每个字须各用独立词义证据。

summary.en: The comparison models two independently evidenced constructions—ONE + TURNED → WHOLE and SPACE + TIME → COSMOS—then marks ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE as a cognitive-geometric extension.
summary.zh-Hans: 比较并列两条独立有据的构词结构——ONE＋TURNED→WHOLE 与 SPACE＋TIME→COSMOS；ROTATION→VORTEX／CURL／ENCLOSURE 另标为认知—几何延伸。

claim.en: Abstract → Motion → Geometry → Symbol: TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE.

summary.en: Cognitive Trace, the author’s spiral-motion proposal, and Cosmic Motion Encoding are explicitly speculative/testable. Etymology does not establish a scientific model of the universe.
summary.zh-Hans: 语言认知痕迹、作者螺旋运动设想与宇宙运动编码均明确标为推测性／可检验；词源不能建立宇宙的科学模型。

claim.en: Language may preserve traces of how earlier human communities perceived, categorized, and modeled the world.
claim.zh-Hans: 语言可能保存早期人类群体感知、分类和构造世界模型的痕迹。

claim.en: Perhaps ancient people recognized rotational or spiral motion in the universe and preserved that cognition in structures such as universe.
claim.zh-Hans: 也许古人已经认识到宇宙具有旋转或螺旋式运动，并将这种认知保留在 universe 一类语言结构之中。

claim.en: Terms for cosmic totality may recruit ONE / TURN / CYCLE / ENCLOSE / SPACE / TIME more often than suitable controls across languages and cultures.
claim.zh-Hans: 跨语言／文化的宇宙整体词汇，是否比适当对照更频繁调用 ONE／TURN／CYCLE／ENCLOSE／SPACE／TIME。

claim.en: Modern Mandarin: 斡 wò, 涡 wō, 窝 wō, 蜗 wō. Their nearby modern forms motivate a cluster test only.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代普通话：斡 wò、涡 wō、窝 wō、蜗 wō；相近的现代读音只用于提出聚类检验。

limitations.en: No historical sound correspondence, shared Chinese etymon or Latin–Chinese cognacy is claimed. Historical pronunciations are omitted here unless tied to a named reconstruction or lexicographic source.
limitations.zh-Hans: 不主张规律历史音变、汉字共同语源或拉丁—汉语同源；未能逐项绑定具名重构或字书来源的历史音不写入。

semantic_structure.relation: ONE + TURNED → WHOLE | TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE | SPACE + TIME → COSMOS

claim.en: Modern wò/wō forms may show a testable concentration around TURN / CURVE / ROTATION.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代 wò／wō 形式可能在 TURN／CURVE／ROTATION 周围形成可检验聚集。

counterexamples: Modern homophony does not establish shared origin
蜗 is primarily an animal name

testability.en: Build a pre-registered Mandarin lexical sample with frequency-matched syllable controls and independent semantic coding.
testability.zh-Hans: 建立预注册的普通话词汇样本，以频率匹配音节作对照，并进行独立语义编码。

claim.en: Language may preserve traces of how earlier human communities perceived, categorized, and modeled the world.
claim.zh-Hans: 语言可能保存早期人类群体感知、分类和构造世界模型的痕迹。

counterexamples: Lexicalization can be opaque to later speakers
Parallel metaphors need not reflect the same historical cognition

testability.en: Compare independently coded historical lexical constructions across unrelated language families and time periods.
testability.zh-Hans: 跨无亲缘语系与历史时期，对历史构词结构进行独立编码比较。

claim.en: Perhaps ancient people recognized rotational or spiral motion in the universe and preserved that cognition in structures such as universe.
claim.zh-Hans: 也许古人已经认识到宇宙具有旋转或螺旋式运动，并将这种认知保留在 universe 一类语言结构之中。

supporting_cases: TURN is historically present in the Latin formation
counterexamples: Scientific claim: not established by etymology
TURN → spiral cosmos is an additional inference

testability.en: Require independent historical texts showing a cosmic rotation model linked to the lexical choice; etymology alone is insufficient.
testability.zh-Hans: 必须找到独立历史文本，显示宇宙旋转模型与该词汇选择有关；仅凭词源不足。

claim.en: Cosmic-totality expressions may recruit ONE / TURN / CYCLE / ENCLOSE / SPACE / TIME more often than matched non-cosmic concepts.
claim.zh-Hans: 表达宇宙整体的词语，可能比匹配的非宇宙概念更频繁调用 ONE／TURN／CYCLE／ENCLOSE／SPACE／TIME。

counterexamples: Borrowing and genealogical dependence must be controlled

testability.en: Pre-register languages, etymological sources, semantic coding, genealogical controls and a comparison baseline.
testability.zh-Hans: 预注册语言样本、词源来源、语义编码、谱系控制与比较基线。

proposition.en: The universe is a poem written by existence itself.
proposition.zh-Hans: 宇宙是存在本身写下的一首诗。

evidence_boundary.en: Literature may explore freely, but it is not historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文学可以自由展开，但不属于历史证据。

editorial_notes.en: Language may preserve cognitive traces, but etymology alone cannot establish the physical structure of the universe.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 语言可以保存认知痕迹，但不能仅由词源反推出宇宙物理结构。

editorial_notes.en: No single Chinese character is selected as the unique primary structural mapping; candidates retain evidence-specific grades.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 不把任何单一汉字选作唯一主要结构映射；各候选保留各自证据等级。

lexical_meaning.en: The totality of space, time, matter and energy; also a complete conceptual world.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: 空间、时间、物质与能量的整体；也可指完整的概念世界。

notes.en: Cross-language lexical mapping based on totalizing semantic structure, not cognacy.
notes.zh-Hans: 基于整体语义结构的跨语言词汇对应，不主张同源。

rationale.en: No G.1 object-level AI review has been completed.
rationale.zh-Hans: 尚未完成 G.1 对象级 AI 审核。

featured_structural_mapping.status: Historical-unit Phonetic-Semantic Candidate; semantic direct / phonetic not evaluated

boundary.en: Featured for the semantic operation TURN / ROTATION; it is not the standard translation and no Latin–Chinese cognacy is claimed.
boundary.zh-Hans: 用于突出 TURN／ROTATION 语义操作；它不是通用翻译，也不主张拉丁语与汉语同源。

latin_decomposition.chain: Latin universus → UNI (unus) + VERS (versus ← vertere) → ONE + TURNED → WHOLE

modern_verse_note.en: Modern English verse ‘poetic line’ belongs to the wider historical TURN family through Latin versus ‘line/row’; it is not the operative modern meaning used to decompose universe.
modern_verse_note.zh-Hans: 现代英语 verse“诗行”虽经拉丁 versus“行列”属于更广的 TURN 词族，但不是拆解 universe 时采用的现代核心义。

note.en: Direct Chinese semantic equivalent for ONE.
note.zh-Hans: ONE 的直接汉语语义对应。

note.en: Shuowen glosses 轉 as 運也; later records include motion and rotation.
note.zh-Hans: 《说文》释“轉”为“運也”；后世记录移动与旋转义。

note.en: Guangya/lexicographic record: 斡，轉也. No Latin relation follows.
note.zh-Hans: 《广雅》等字书载“斡，轉也”；不能据此推出拉丁语关系。

note.en: A rotating current / eddy; historical lexicography records 回川 with the gloss 旋流.
note.zh-Hans: 旋转水流／漩涡；字书有“回川”并注“旋流”。

note.en: Nest, recess and ‘bend’ motivate enclosure/curve imagery; a historical ROTATION sense is not established.
note.zh-Hans: 巢穴、凹陷与“弄弯”可引出包围／曲线意象；未确立历史 ROTATION 义。

note.en: The word denotes a snail; spiral geometry comes from the shell’s form, not from a lexical meaning ‘rotate.’
note.zh-Hans: 本字指蜗牛；螺旋几何来自壳的形态，不是“旋转”的词汇义。

note.en: Around, cycle, complete/all; semantically useful but outside the modern WO sound cluster.
note.zh-Hans: 具有环绕、循环、周全／全部等义；语义上有用，但不属于现代 WO 音簇。

note.en: Joining/closing models the result of bringing parts together, not TURN itself.
note.zh-Hans: 聚合／闭合可表示诸部分成为整体的结果，并非 TURN 本身。

note.en: Complete/entire models the outcome WHOLE, not the turning operation.
note.zh-Hans: 完整／全部对应结果 WHOLE，并非旋转操作。

geometry_mapping.chain: Abstract → Motion → Geometry → Symbol | TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE

boundary.en: This is a cognitive-geometric mapping, not the historical meaning of every form in the chain.
boundary.zh-Hans: 这是认知—几何映射，不是链上每一形式的历史词义。

traditional_chinese_construction.status: Supported interpretation in specified historical contexts; not a universal original construction
traditional_chinese_construction.chain: 宇 + 宙 → SPACE + TIME → COSMOS

boundary.en: Specified historical interpretation, not morpheme-for-morpheme Latin equivalence.
boundary.zh-Hans: 指定历史语境中的空间—时间解释；不声称与拉丁构词逐字同构或所有古代用法一致。

evidence_boundary.en: Translation is not Mapping; semantic resemblance is not cognacy; etymology cannot by itself establish the physical structure of the universe.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: Translation 不等于 Mapping；语义相似不等于同源；不能仅由词源推断宇宙物理结构。

boundary.en: Featured for the semantic operation TURN / ROTATION; it is not the standard translation and no Latin–Chinese cognacy is claimed.
boundary.zh-Hans: 用于突出 TURN／ROTATION 语义操作；它不是通用翻译，也不主张拉丁语与汉语同源。

latin_decomposition.chain: Latin universus → UNI (unus) + VERS (versus ← vertere) → ONE + TURNED → WHOLE

modern_verse_note.en: Modern English verse ‘poetic line’ belongs to the wider historical TURN family through Latin versus ‘line/row’; it is not the operative modern meaning used to decompose universe.
modern_verse_note.zh-Hans: 现代英语 verse“诗行”虽经拉丁 versus“行列”属于更广的 TURN 词族，但不是拆解 universe 时采用的现代核心义。

note.en: Direct Chinese semantic equivalent for ONE.
note.zh-Hans: ONE 的直接汉语语义对应。

note.en: Shuowen glosses 轉 as 運也; later records include motion and rotation.
note.zh-Hans: 《说文》释“轉”为“運也”；后世记录移动与旋转义。

note.en: Guangya/lexicographic record: 斡，轉也. No Latin relation follows.
note.zh-Hans: 《广雅》等字书载“斡，轉也”；不能据此推出拉丁语关系。

note.en: A rotating current / eddy; historical lexicography records 回川 with the gloss 旋流.
note.zh-Hans: 旋转水流／漩涡；字书有“回川”并注“旋流”。

note.en: Nest, recess and ‘bend’ motivate enclosure/curve imagery; a historical ROTATION sense is not established.
note.zh-Hans: 巢穴、凹陷与“弄弯”可引出包围／曲线意象；未确立历史 ROTATION 义。

note.en: The word denotes a snail; spiral geometry comes from the shell’s form, not from a lexical meaning ‘rotate.’
note.zh-Hans: 本字指蜗牛；螺旋几何来自壳的形态，不是“旋转”的词汇义。

note.en: Around, cycle, complete/all; semantically useful but outside the modern WO sound cluster.
note.zh-Hans: 具有环绕、循环、周全／全部等义；语义上有用，但不属于现代 WO 音簇。

note.en: Joining/closing models the result of bringing parts together, not TURN itself.
note.zh-Hans: 聚合／闭合可表示诸部分成为整体的结果，并非 TURN 本身。

note.en: Complete/entire models the outcome WHOLE, not the turning operation.
note.zh-Hans: 完整／全部对应结果 WHOLE，并非旋转操作。

geometry_mapping.chain: Abstract → Motion → Geometry → Symbol | TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE

boundary.en: This is a cognitive-geometric mapping, not the historical meaning of every form in the chain.
boundary.zh-Hans: 这是认知—几何映射，不是链上每一形式的历史词义。

traditional_chinese_construction.chain: 宇 + 宙 → SPACE + TIME → COSMOS

boundary.en: This Chinese construction is independent of the Latin decomposition.
boundary.zh-Hans: 这条中文传统构词链独立于拉丁语拆解。

evidence_boundary.en: Translation is not Mapping; semantic resemblance is not cognacy; etymology cannot by itself establish the physical structure of the universe.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: Translation 不等于 Mapping；语义相似不等于同源；不能仅由词源推断宇宙物理结构。
